name: convention-top-level-spread
description: A default export that spreads another object into itself is not read, because the spread may set the property, so the run ends with the convention-not-literal setup failure naming the configuration file and the property. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named react-router for the package @react-router/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory property of react-router.config.ts moves.
